source_snapshot.procedure: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, filter VOLT, inspect BMC Web and preserve anomalies; source has outer quotation marks.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor identity/readings in both lists and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 31 and text has outer quotes.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents a title sensor, truncates OOB-only data and omits the complete rail/power-tree/Web scope.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires full rail map, units/scaling/limits and source-format clarification.

old_problem: A broad VOLT filter has no authoritative rail population, power-domain ownership, units/scaling, nominal values or tolerance/threshold map. DeepSeek substitutes one nonexistent title sensor. Historical review also treated the extra enclosing quotes and 1/2/31 numbering as decisions.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict because ED-03 permits the board/PSU/VR rail map and runtime load state as Project Configuration, while ED-15 requires approved electrical limits rather than guesses. The extra quotes and numbering gap are recorded as editorial defects that do not erase the three explicit checks. Validation remains passive telemetry reconciliation; calibrated live measurement is a separate approved procedure if required.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2026 including its literal outer quotes, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2027 / Wistron-BMC-01047-V002 / 68403ec4161f4aef.
Every voltage record must map to a named rail and electrical owner in the board power tree; a generic matching string cannot prove complete rail coverage.

Units and scaling are applied only from the versioned sensor/board specification, with nominal, tolerance, thresholds, freshness and unavailable behavior assessed under documented power/load/redundancy state.
IB/OOB/Web agreement proves telemetry parity, not calibrated electrical accuracy. No live probing is introduced by this review.
Outer quotes and criteria 1/2/31 are preserved as source defects; missing criteria 3-30 are not created.
No ipmitool, power query, live electrical measurement, authentication, Web capture, power/threshold change, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Verify the complete voltage-sensor population by binding each record to a named board/PSU/VR rail and reconciling scaled value, units, state, thresholds and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web under a documented power state and load.
required_package: SUT/BMC/board/PSU/VR revisions and versioned authoritative power tree
Complete per-rail population, electrical-domain ownership and five-view sensor crosswalk
Approved units/scaling, nominal value, tolerance, thresholds, state/freshness/unavailable rules
Documented power/load/redundancy context, approved ipmitool and protected OOB/Web access
Power/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility; calibrated procedure only if accuracy is explicitly in scope
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; freeze board/PSU/VR identity, power/load/redundancy state and the approved rail matrix. Preserve logs. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs before VOLT filtering and every BMC Web rail row/page. Apply only approved per-rail units/scaling, nominal/tolerance/threshold/freshness rules and compare all views. Do not use the title as a sensor, truncate, probe live rails, alter power/VR/thresholds, clear logs, silently convert units or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every required rail appears exactly once with correct electrical ownership and fresh SPEC-valid scaled values/states/thresholds in all five views, with no unexpected over/undervoltage, PSU/VR or SEL condition.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the complete signed rail matrix, approved scaling/limits, documented power state/load and full five-view evidence. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/stale rail, wrong ownership or units, cross-view mismatch, exceeded approved limit or new power fault. Missing rail map/scaling/limits is NOT READY; shared telemetry is not proof of calibrated accuracy; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive telemetry only; no live probing, power transition, PSU/VR configuration or threshold write.
Protect credentials and preserve complete inventories and power/SEL context before filtering.
Stop on ambiguous rail, scaling uncertainty, over/undervoltage, PSU/VR fault, mismatch or stale data.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first electrical state and anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact source identity including quote/numbering defects and SUT/BMC/board/PSU/VR inventory
Versioned power tree and complete per-rail five-view map with units/scaling/limits
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for every rail
Per-rail normalized comparison plus power/load/redundancy/PSU/VR/SEL context
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, access failure, ambiguous rail/scaling, mismatch, over/undervoltage or power fault, stop passive collection and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not probe, alter power/VR/thresholds, clear logs or retry; escalate the named rail and power domain to power/BMC owners.

source_conflict.reason: A signed power-tree rail matrix supplies population/scaling/limits; outer quotes and 1/2/31 are explicitly retained as editorial defects rather than unresolved semantics.

blocked.reason: Passive telemetry semantics, evidence, safety and recovery are complete; concrete rail map and limits are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Board power tree, complete rail ownership/crosswalk, units/scaling/nominal/tolerance/threshold/freshness rules and power/load/redundancy state.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO PER-RAIL PASSIVE TELEMETRY MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, POWER QUERY, LIVE PROBE, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, POWER/VR/THRESHOLD CHANGE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
